description: This file contains utility functions for the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 implementation, including stream manipulation, request modification, hash calculation, and URI handling.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for stream manipulation, request modification, URI handling, and other PSR-7 related helpers.

methods.name: caselessRemove
methods.description: Removes items from an array case-insensitively based on provided keys.

methods.name: copyToStream
methods.description: Copies data from a source stream to a destination stream up to a maximum length.

methods.name: copyToString
methods.description: Reads a stream into a string up to a specified maximum length.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Calculates a hash of a stream’s contents using a specified algorithm.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Clones and modifies a PSR-7 request with specified changes such as headers, method, URI, body, etc.

methods.name: readLine
methods.description: Reads a line from a stream up to a maximum length.

methods.name: streamFor
methods.description: Creates or returns a PSR-7 stream based on various resource types, strings, iterators, or callables.

methods.name: tryFopen
methods.description: Opens a file stream safely, throwing an exception on failure.

methods.name: uriFor
methods.description: Returns a UriInterface for a given string or UriInterface.
